name: Himekawa Mizuha
source:
A member of the art club. His father is the master of Japanese painters and he lives in a large Japanese house. To him, oil painting is a slight rebellion against his father who is too respectable.

He seems to be acquainted with [url=https://vndb.org/c16723]Usami[/url], the public health doctor.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080611152914/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/natuiro_cyara_mizuha.html]official website[/url]]
